description_en: Lists the resources in a service instance
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceResources查询服务实例包含的资源
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-resources --service-instance-id si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceResources

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set this to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance
parameters.name: service_instance_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the resource
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource in the service instance. Valid values:

AliyunResource: an Alibaba Cloud resource.

ContainerResource: a pod
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例资源类型。可能的值：

AliyunResource：阿里云资源。

ContainerResource：容器组（Pod）资源
parameters.name: service_instance_resource_type

fields.help_en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more filter names to query resources. Valid values:

ExpireTimeStart

ExpireTimeEnd

PayType

ResourceARN
fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

ExpireTimeStart
ExpireTimeEnd
PayType 
ResourceARN
fields.name: name

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。每页最大行数100行，默认行数20行

NextToken.description_en: The token to start the next query

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围：

Subscription：预付费。

PayAsYouGo：后付费

RenewStatus.description_en:
The renewal status. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: auto-renewal.

ManualRenewal: manual renewal.

NotRenewal: no renewal
RenewStatus.description_zh:
续费状态，取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费。

ManualRenewal：手动续费。

NotRenewal：不续费

RenewalPeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

Month: month.

Year: year
RenewalPeriodUnit.description_zh:
续费周期单位。取值范围：

Month：月。

Year：年

ResourceARN.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

INIT_COMPLETE: The resource is pending creation.

CREATE_COMPLETE: The resource is created.

CREATE_FAILED: The resource failed to be created.

CREATE_IN_PROGRESS: The resource is being created.

UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: The resource is being updated.

UPDATE_FAILED: The resource failed to be updated.

UPDATE_COMPLETE: The resource is updated.

DELETE_IN_PROGRESS: The resource is being deleted.

DELETE_FAILED: The resource failed to be deleted.

DELETE_COMPLETE: The resource is deleted.

CHECK_IN_PROGRESS: The resource is being checked.

CHECK_FAILED: The resource failed to be checked.

CHECK_COMPLETE: The resource is checked.

IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS: The resource is being imported.

IMPORT_FAILED: The resource failed to be imported.

IMPORT_COMPLETE: The resource is imported
Status.description_zh:
资源状态。取值：
INIT_COMPLETE：资源待创建。

CREATE_COMPLETE：资源创建完成。
CREATE_FAILED：资源创建失败。
CREATE_IN_PROGRESS：资源创建中。
UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS：资源更新中。
UPDATE_FAILED：资源更新失败。
UPDATE_COMPLETE：资源更新完成。
DELETE_IN_PROGRESS：资源删除中。
DELETE_FAILED：资源删除失败。
DELETE_COMPLETE：资源删除完成。
CHECK_IN_PROGRESS：资源校验中。
CHECK_FAILED：资源校验失败。
CHECK_COMPLETE：资源校验完成。
IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS：资源导入中。
IMPORT_FAILED：资源导入失败。
IMPORT_COMPLETE：资源导入完成
